QuestInfo.name: To Another Dimension
QuestInfo.0: Fenelle has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: Fenelle recommended you do your training in another dimension. Go to Maple World's #bBowman Instructional School#k and talk to #bAthena Pierce#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met Athena Pierce, the representative of Maple World's adventurers. She recommended you go to one of the following places: #bEllinel Fairy Academy, Gold Beach Resort, Riena Strait, and Secret Forest Elodin#k.

0.msg: Click on the Interdimensional Portal on the right to go to #bHenesys#k. Once you arrive, go to the #bBowman Instructional School#k and find #bAthena Pierce#k.
